summary: MN8 Energy LLC is the continuing Delaware solar-and-storage platform formerly known as Goldman Sachs Renewable Power LLC, beneath MN8 Energy Holdings LLC after a March 2024 reorganization. Current filed SEC materials directly verify the 2024 Series A preferred issuance to Mercuria Clean Energy Investments BV and WSI Fund II Holdings, LP, the Ridgewood fund chain, WSI's below-10-percent as-converted entry recital and non-voting observer right, current UC Regents and preferred-holder consent roles, approximately 1,370 separate common holders at merger signing, and the July 2026 signed-pending acquisition of Greenbacker by MN8. They do not publish the complete cutoff-current named common-member register, every legal vehicle, units, votes, nominee or transfer history, exact cutoff preferred stakes and votes, management equity ledger or complete former-holder set. Greenbacker is the target and remains signed pending, so neither Greenbacker nor its holders are current MN8 owners. A partial correction would misstate the current owner after-image; the only safe terminal outcome is a fresh exact deferral.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The platform identity and continuity are resolved in the filed S-4: MN8 Energy LLC is a Delaware limited liability company formed on 2017-09-19 and formerly known as Goldman Sachs Renewable Power LLC. MN8 Energy Holdings LLC became the parent and managing-member topco in the March 2024 reorganization while MN8 Energy LLC remained the Series A issuer.

The March 2024 preferred holders are directly verified. WSI Fund II Holdings, LP f/k/a MN8 Fund II Holdings, L.P. is the Ridgewood investor member, and Mercuria Clean Energy Investments BV is the Mercuria investor. The filed S-4 supplies the Ridgewood Fund II and parallel-fund control chain and Mercuria parent relationship.

The filed observer agreement verifies WSI's less-than-10-percent as-converted recital at entry and a non-voting observer right subject to a retention threshold. Those facts do not establish a cutoff percentage or control.

The Greenbacker direction and current state are corrected from the direct merger filings: MN8 is the buyer, Monarch Merger Sub will merge into Greenbacker, Greenbacker will survive as an MN8 Energy subsidiary, and Greenbacker holders may elect cash, MN8 units or mixed consideration subject to proration only at closing. The current Greenbacker 10-Q still calls the transaction proposed and expected in Q4 2026 subject to conditions.

The current filed S-4 verifies the manager-level operating scope at 2026-03-31: approximately 870 projects in 29 states, approximately 3.9 GW of operating and under-construction solar, approximately 440 MW of operating and under-construction battery storage and more than 200 enterprise customers. Project and tax-equity entities remain beneath the one MN8 platform.

ownershipResolution.commonMembers: The filed S-4 reports approximately 1,370 separate common holders at merger signing and identifies Goldman Sachs Asset Management and the Regents of the University of California as consent parties. It supplies certain future-closing allocations and beneficial-ownership categories, including Goldman Sachs RP Holdings, UC Regents and confidential PWM-client interests. It does not disclose the complete cutoff-current named holder register, every legal vehicle, nominee relationship, units, votes, transfers, redemptions or complete former-holder history.
ownershipResolution.ridgewoodPreferred: WSI Fund II Holdings, LP f/k/a MN8 Fund II Holdings, L.P. is the Ridgewood investor member. The filed S-4 says it is controlled through Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Fund II, L.P. and Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Parallel Fund II, L.P. The observer agreement recites less than 10% as converted at entry and provides a non-voting observer right. Exact cutoff units, percentage, votes, PIK accruals, transfers, conversion, redemption and control remain unavailable.
ownershipResolution.mercuriaPreferred: Mercuria Clean Energy Investments BV, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Mercuria Energy Group Limited, is the other Series A preferred holder. The filed materials verify the original $200 million component and future exchange mechanics but not exact cutoff units, percentage, votes, PIK accruals, transfers, conversion or redemption.
ownershipResolution.march2024Financing: The S-4 describes a $325 million Series A preferred issuance in March 2024 to Ridgewood and Mercuria. The accepted response records $200 million from Mercuria and $125 million from WSI, a 2023-12-22 purchase agreement and 2024-03-28 close, senior economics, 10% cumulative cash or PIK distributions, conversion and protective provisions, holder redemption after year seven and company call rights after year two. Those terms do not prove a complete cutoff cap table or control.
prohibitedInferences: Do not infer the complete approximately 1,370-holder common register, legal vehicles, units, stakes, votes, nominee relationships, transfers, redemptions or former-holder history from aggregate counts, future-closing allocation tables, consent parties or beneficial-ownership categories.

Do not infer Ridgewood or Mercuria's exact cutoff stake, votes or company control from original dollar investment, fund chain, preferred rights, less-than-10-percent entry recital, board or observer rights, future exchange mechanics or portfolio-page continuity.

Do not infer Goldman Sachs RP Holdings or any GSAM or PWM client cutoff status, stake, transfer or exit from historic formation, internalization, consent language, future-closing allocation tables or silence.
Do not treat Greenbacker, its members or receiving holders as current MN8 owners before a filed legal close and final elections, proration, funds flow, exchanges and post-close register.

Do not treat MN8 project companies, tax-equity partnerships, lenders, secured parties, offtakers, customers, developers, EPC contractors, asset buyers or sellers, joint ventures or advisers as platform equity holders absent direct evidence.
